Quorum Code: AddSlider(text name, number minimum, number maximum, number step)
Explanation: Adds a slider to a form page. The name is what a screen reader says. AddSlider(name) makes a slider from 0 to 100.

Quorum Code: AddSliderField(text name, number minimum, number maximum, number step)
Explanation: Adds a slider with a number box beside it.
Sets the slider's number from code. A number outside the range is moved to the nearest end.
Returns the number as text, with as many decimal places as the step needs, such as "0.25" or "40".
Sets a word a screen reader says after the number.
Finds a slider on a page by its name. GetSliderField finds a slider field.
Tells the listener each time a person changes the number.
The action a listener writes. The event's GetNewValue, GetOldValue and IsFinal say what changed.
